An '''outpost''' existed during [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], located on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. The outpost was constructed during 19 BBY, the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] event that had been ravaging the galaxy since [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The outpost was created by the [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], however, discovered the outpost and sent their own [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]] after the outpost, in the form of a battalion of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Whatever [[Ground warfare/Legends|combat]] that ensued was broken up, however, by the appearance of a massive [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain|beast]] that destroyed all of the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, sans [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Endor)|one battle droid]], and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the clone troopers. When the clone troopers failed to report back, the Republic sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to [[Mission to Endor (Clone Wars)|investigate]]. She learned of the events from the surviving [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and the local [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], and with the battle droid, she went off to destroy the beast. The battle droid was destroyed during the fight with the beast, but Secura nevertheless managed to kill the beast. The Ewoks immortalized Secura, the droid, and the beast in a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]. The outpost was then abandoned completely.<ref name="what goes up" />

==Behind the scenes==
The outpost first appeared in [[What Goes Up... (comic story)|''What Goes Up...'']], a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] collected in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5]]'' and written and illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]]. The events of the comic were later in referenced in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]], [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Bob Vitas]].<ref name="what goes up" />
